title: Price Accuracy Promise — Merchandise Purchases Rung Above the Shelf Ticket
content:
**The Promise.** A Merchandise Purchases unit of regular price type whose selling price on the purchase record is above its shelf ticket price (the regular price on the same record) was rung above its shelf ticket, and the Price Accuracy Promise corrects it as a register-error price adjustment refunded to the unit's original tender.

**Scope.** For a unit rung above its shelf ticket that this policy handles, and only for such a unit, the register-error adjustment is still made at any time while the unit is not returned and still counts toward no limit, and it refunds the shelf overcharge with its sales tax together with the price-accuracy credit; every other register error, including registry credit recorded as spent but left undeducted; the card money taken for a Finch Note recorded as redeemed but left undeducted; sales tax charged on the part a Finch Note paid; gift card or Bonus Card value recorded as redeemed but left undeducted; and a second capture of the same tender, stays under the base rule or the rule written for it.

**What is recorded.** The new unit price recorded on the correction is the shelf ticket price.

## The Promise in condition and result

- **Condition:** the purchase record shows price type regular and a selling price above the regular price, and the unit is not returned.
- **Judgement:** the unit was rung above its shelf ticket.
- **Result:** a register-error price adjustment refunded to the unit's original tender, recording the shelf ticket price as the new unit price.

The correction is made at any time while the unit is not returned, whatever the age of the purchase, and it does not count toward any limit on price adjustments.

## Booking the correction — `correct_shelf_price_8a80c6f7`

**Capability.** Books a shelf-price correction on one purchase record: a register-error price adjustment for a unit that rang up above its shelf ticket, stating the price the unit should have rung at and the amount refunded. On success one price adjustment entry is added to the unit's records with the current date, the reason register price error, the corrected price and the amount; the amount goes back to the tender the unit was paid with, and the unit's amount paid and not refunded goes down by the same amount. The corrected price is recorded only on the new price adjustment entry; the unit's selling price on the purchase record is left as rung. The customer sees the refund on the original tender.

**How it is invoked.** `correct_shelf_price_8a80c6f7` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `purchase_id` | the reference number of the purchase record (one unit of one item) being corrected, as returned by the purchase lookup for this customer | identifier text |
| `new_unit_price` | the price the unit should have rung at, recorded as the new unit price on the price adjustment entry | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; never empty |
| `amount` | the total refunded by this correction | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; never empty |

No parameter takes an enumerated value.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new price adjustment reference number (an opaque text reference), the purchase record reference number, the corrected unit price and the amount refunded (both USD with 2 decimal places), the tender refunded, and the unit's remaining amount paid and not refunded (USD, 2 decimal places). A sentence starting with "Shelf-price correction booked" means the entry was recorded.
